import random

def compute_A(a):
    n = len(a)
    sum_val = 0
    for x in range(n):
        prod = 1
        for y in range(n):
            if x == y:
                continue
            prod *= (a[x] * a[y] - 1) / (a[x] - a[y])
        sum_val += prod
    return sum_val

# Test i=1 (n=2)
a = [random.uniform(3, 9), random.uniform(9, 27)]
print(f"i=1: {compute_A(a)}")

# Test i=2 (n=3)
a = [random.uniform(3, 9), random.uniform(9, 27), random.uniform(27, 81)]
print(f"i=2: {compute_A(a)}")

# Test i=3 (n=4)
a = [random.uniform(3, 9), random.uniform(9, 27), random.uniform(27, 81), random.uniform(81, 243)]
print(f"i=3: {compute_A(a)}")
